sentences.en: The survivors were found on an island, dying of starvation.
sentences.zh: 1. 生存者们被发现在一个岛上，濒临饿死。

sentences.en: The poor cat was on the verge of starvation.
sentences.zh: 2. 那只可怜的猫快要饿死了。

sentences.en: The poor child was on the verge of starvation.
sentences.zh: 3. 这个可怜的孩子快要饿死了。

senses.zh: (常造成死亡的) 饥饿，挨饿
